metadata.title: EF-REG-009 - Connected service errors expose retryable user feedback
titlePath: EF-REG-009 - Connected service errors expose retryable user feedback

payload.script: const body=document.body.innerText; const key='EFREG009-Recovery'; const cards=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article,section,[class*="card"]')).map(e=>(e.innerText||'').trim()).filter(t=>t.includes(key)); return {href:location.href,queue:(body.match(/\d+ expenses waiting on[^\n]*/)||[])[0]||null,targetPresent:body.includes(key),cardCount:cards.length,cards:cards.slice(0,3)};

const body=document.body.innerText; const target='EFREG009-Recovery'; return {href:location.href,queue:(body.match(/\d+ expenses waiting on[^\n]*/)||[])[0]||null,targetPresent:body.includes(target),targetCount:(body.match(new RegExp(target,'g'))||[]).length,visibleSynthetic:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article,section,[class*="card"]')).map(e=>(e.innerText||'').trim()).filter(t=>t.includes('EFREG')).slice(0,12)};
